title: エネルギーデバイス工学
subtitle: Energy Devices
keywords: Environment / energy 2.Energy conversion device 3.Electrochemical device 4.Photo/ thermoelectric, piezoelectric conversion 5.Power storage technology
educationalGoal: Harmonization with the environment is required to utilize modern electric energy. In this course, students learn the social background of environmental energy. Next, primary batteries, secondary batteries, fuel cells, solar cells, piezoelectric / thermoelectric conversion elements, etc. are taught as important energy conversion devices constituting an electric energy system. The development trend, the situation of practical use, the structure, the operation principle, and the characteristics are learned.
advice: The following topics will be addressed in this lecture. 1. Environmental energy problems and energy conversion applied devices Current status of environmental energy problems / Overview of various energy conversion application devices 2. Fundamentals of electrochemical energy conversion Electrolysis and battery / principle of voltage generation / principle of current generation 3. Operation principle of electrochemical device Primary battery / Secondary battery / Fuel cell / Electric double layer capacitor 4. Fundamentals of photoelectric conversion, thermoelectric conversion, and piezoelectric conversion Principle of photovoltaic generation / Principle of thermoelectric generation / Principle of piezoelectric effect 5. Operating principle of photoelectric conversion, thermoelectric conversion, and piezoelectric conversion device Solar cell / Thermoelectric device / Piezoelectric device 6. Other power storage technologies
requiredKnowledge: This subject covers a wide range of energy conversion & storage technologies resulting from environmental energy problems. Therefore, in addition to knowledge in the fields of chemistry and physics, it is an integrated subject that requires a social perspective on the environment. Work to deepen understanding while referring to textbooks in each field as appropriate.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain global environmental energy issues and the role of various energy conversion devices.
Be able to explain an overview of electrochemical energy conversion, which is the basis of batteries
Be able to explain the characteristics of various devices to which electrochemical energy conversion is applied.
Be able to explain the principle of photoelectric, thermoelectric, and piezoelectric conversion and its applicat
Be able to explain the type, operation principle and development status about the power storage technologies.

achievementLevels.ideal: 1 Explain in detail the global energy policy and technology development trends regarding environmental energy. 2 Explain the principle of electrochemical energy conversion theoretically. 3 Explain the principles and features of primary cells, secondary cells, fuel cells and EDLC. 4 Explain the operating principle and characteristics of photoelectric conversion, thermoelectric conversion, and piezoelectric conversion device in detail in relation to the constituent materials. 5 Explain the principles and characteristics of various power storage technologies in detail.
achievementLevels.standard: 1 Explain Japan's environmental energy policy and technology development trends. 2 Explain the principle of electrochemical energy conversion. 3 Explain the principles and features of electrochemical devices such as primary batteries, secondary batteries, fuel cells, and electric double layer capacitors. 4 Explain the operating principle of photoelectric conversion, thermoelectric conversion, and piezoelectric conversion device. 5 Give an overview of various power storage technologies.

lessons.content: Guidance Trends in technologies related to the environment and energy self-check
lessons.assignments: In reference to e syllabus, understand the flow of classes. Deepen understanding of environmental and energy issues.

lessons.content: Trends in technologies related to the environment and energy Overview of various energy conversion application devices self-check
lessons.assignments: In reference to e syllabus, understand the flow of classes. Deepen understanding of environmental and energy issues.

lessons.content: Principles of electrochemical energy conversion ・Principle of voltage generation (Chemical energy / electrical energy) ・Electrolysis and battery self-check
lessons.assignments: Read textbooks Chapter 1 and 2 .1 to gain a better understanding of electrochemical energy conversion and principles of voltage generation.

lessons.content: Principle of voltage generation ・Electrode potential and electromotive force ・Nernst's equation self-check
lessons.assignments: Read textbook chapter 2.2 to gain a better understanding of the principles of voltage generation.

lessons.content: Principle of current generation ・Electric double layer theory ・Faraday's law ・Electron transfer process ・Butler-Volmer equation self-check
lessons.assignments: Read textbooks Chapters 3 and 4 to gain a better understanding of the current in the electron transfer process.

lessons.content: Principle of current generation ・Mass transfer process ・Fick's diffusion equation Self-check
lessons.assignments: Read Chapter 4 of the textbook to gain a better understanding of the current in the mass transfer process.

lessons.operation: Intermediate test Lecture, question and answer
lessons.assignments: Review the contents of the first six lectures for the intermediate test.

lessons.content: Photoelectrochemical, Primary battery, Secondary battery ・Type of battery ・Operation of semiconductor electrode Self-check
lessons.assignments: Read textbooks chapters 5, 8 and 9 to gain a better understanding of battery types and operating principles.

lessons.content: Fuel cell ・Type and operation principle of fuel cell Electric double layer capacitor ・Operation principle of electric double layer capacitor ・Difference with battery Self-check
lessons.assignments: Read Chapter 10 for a better understanding of fuel cells. Read Chapter 3 and deepen your understanding of the electrical double layer capacitor

lessons.content: Photoelectric conversion device ・Principle of light absorption in substance ・Photovoltaic effect in semiconductor junctions (Light energy / electrical energy) ・Solar cell Self-check
lessons.assignments: Deepen understanding of the principle of light absorption and photovoltaic generation of semiconductor with reference to e-syllabus.

lessons.content: Thermoelectric conversion device ・Seebeck effect ・Peltier effect ・Various thermoelectric materials, thermal power generation devices Self-check
lessons.assignments: Understand the principles of the Seebeck effect and the Peltier effect referring to the e syllabus.

lessons.content: Piezoelectric conversion device ・Piezo effect (pressure / electric energy) ・Various piezoelectric materials, piezoelectric devices Self-check
lessons.assignments: Deepen your understanding of the piezo effect in reference to e-syllabus.

lessons.content: Other power storage technologies ・Flywheel ・Superconducting power storage system ・Various power storage technology and distributed power supply, smart grid Self-check
lessons.assignments: Deepen your understanding the structure and operation principle of the flywheel, SMES, etc. referring to the materials of e-syllabus.
Review the lecture content of the examination range in preparation for the achievement confirmation test.

lessons.operation: Explanation of exam contents Class questionnaire
